title: SynthesizedMetaProcedureDAG
description: Schema for meta-procedure outputs synthesized by Planner agents into executable Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs).

goal_specification.description: The high-level technical goal or natural language prompt requested by the user.

weakest_precondition.description: Derived weakest precondition wp(DAG, Q) for safety validation.

certified_safe.description: Indicates whether formal verification passed prior to step execution.

steps.description: Sequenced execution steps forming the DAG.

step_id.description: Unique identifier for this step within the DAG.

procedure_name.description: Name of the tool/procedure to invoke.

arguments_mapping.description: Key-value mapping of parameters, allowing references to previous step outputs (e.g. $steps[1].output.field).

dependencies.description: Array of step_ids that must complete successfully before this step executes.

compensating_procedure.description: Rollback procedure to execute if downstream execution fails.
